findings.scope: Later independent formal review input construction
findings.observed_source: resources = bundle['resource_refs']; required starts with input_ref; every required ref must be present in resources with exact canonical path, sha256 and bytes.
findings.impact: The input JSON must contain its own final file SHA/bytes in its own resource_refs. This is a self-hash fixed-point requirement, so ordinary deterministic bundle construction cannot satisfy it.
findings.proposed_source_fix: Keep input_ref outside bundle.resource_refs; validate and append the actual externally pinned input_ref to the held set at review entry, or supply a separately pinned resource manifest. Reject conflicting aliases. Require independent review of that minimal change.
